description: Findings whose proposed status change was considered and dispositioned — either rejected by the register (refuting_row names the row), or adjudicated out of register scope (not-a-register-claim / absorbed-under-register-id, with the reason in rationale). Never a bare ignore list: every entry carries the reason, and claimlint refuses entries that do not (T269).
